module_catalog.name: Research methodology in anthropology 755
module_catalog.content: Theory and practice of participant observation. Other techniques of data collection used by anthropologists. Organisation and use of field notes. Reflexivity and fieldwork. Practical application of research methods.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1 other contact session per week, 2 lectures per week

module_catalog.name: Politics of identity 756
module_catalog.content: This module builds on the anthropological and ethnographic knowledge students have acquired. With reference to contemporary anthropological theories, students will deepen their insights into the world around them and the discipline itself. This will aid in the development of critical thinking and problem solving skills from a contemporary anthropological perspective.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week, 1 other contact session per week

module_catalog.name: Contemporary ethnography 761
module_catalog.content: The production of ethnographic texts, reflexivity in ethnographic writing, postmodernism, contemporary concerns about ethnographic texts and the “crisis of representation”. A critical reading of three recent ethnographies.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1 other contact session per week, 2 lectures per week

module_catalog.name: Research report: Anthropology 770
module_catalog.content: The honours degree entails one year of full-time study and comprises of coursework, ethnographic field research and examinations as well as a research report of between 12,000 to a maximum of 15,000 words based on field research which must be completed by the end of the academic year.
